title: Aey Mere Laal Akbar(as)
body:
Moula Qadam Qadam Par Ye Keh Rahe Hain Ro Kar,
Aawaz Do Kaha Ho Ay Mere Laal Akbar..
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Gulshan Me Shaahe Di Ke Tareeki Cha Chuki Hai,
Tooti Hui Kamar Hai Binaai Ja Chuki Hai,
Haalat Pe Meri Haste Jaate Hain Sab Sitamgar..
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ab Kon Hai Jo Ran Me Mujko Dikhaye Rasta,
Chaaro Taraf Adu Hai Tanha Hai Tera Baba,
Beta Teri Sada Par Aaunga Ghutno Chal Kar..
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Khud Bhukha Reh Ke Maine Tujko Diya Niwala,
Aththara Saal Tujko Nazo Se Maine Pala,
Ye Bain Kar Rahi Hai Khaimo Me Teri Maadar..
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Barchi Ko Khechne Ki Himmat Kaha Se Laau,
Lasha Uthane Ki Me Taaqat Kaha Se Laau,
Kije Najaf Se Aakar Imdaad Baba Haider..
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ibne Hasan Ka Lasha Gathdi Me La Chuka Hu,
Abbase Bawfa Ke Bazu Utha Chuka Hu,
Mara Gya Hai Lashkar Koi Nahi Hai Sar..
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Tu Hi Mera Sahara Tu Hi Mera Asa Hai,
Baba Ki Jaan Hai Tu Ham Shaqle Mustafa Hai,
Tere Bagair Meri Duniya Hai Khaak Akbar..
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Puchegi Jab Muje Wo Akbar Kaha Hai Baba,
Sugra(S.A) Ko Khat Me Bolo Me Kya Jawab Dunga,
Takti Hai Tera Rasta Yasrab Me Teri Khwahar..
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Bazu Kata Ke Ran Me Soya Hai Mera Bhai,
Gurbat Pe Aaj Meri Roti Hai Ye Khudaai,
Chalta Hai Halqe Sheh Pe Zalim Ka Kund Khanjar..
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Rizwan Ran Me Akbar Aidi Ragad Raha Hai,
Kazim Jawaan Bete Ko Baap Dhundhta Hai,
Karbobala Me Chaaro Janib Bapa Hai Mehshar..
